# Homescape Construction Inc.
> Chicago-based residential and commercial construction company serving the greater Chicago area since 2012.

## About
Homescape Construction Inc. is a full-service construction company specializing in residential remodels, custom home builds, and commercial construction. Founded in 2012, we have completed over 200 projects with a 98% client satisfaction rate.

## Services
- Residential remodeling (kitchens, bathrooms, whole-home)
- Custom home construction
- Commercial tenant improvements
- Design-build services

Chicago, Illinois and surrounding suburbs including:
- Lincoln Park
- Wicker Park
- Lakeview
- North Shore
